title: Menus and save slots in Rust: the kit's keyed menus, slots, toasts and a checked load
note: Menus are the kit's Menu by key, saves are game.saves and ctx.slots(); prove a save by loading it and reading lastLoad.checksumMatch.
intent: Menus and saves are built in. Register game.ui(UiConfig::new().locales(..)) so every word is a key in assets/lang/<locale>.ftl, game.saves(SaveConfig::schema(1).autosave(ticks, ring)) and game.save_world() (World derives Serialize and Deserialize from genex::prelude with #[serde(crate = "genex::serde")]: a game crate never names serde; anything outside sim.world is its own game.save_section). Draw the pause and title menus with Menu::new(key).item(..).back(..).show(ui) in on_ui: it moves by pad or keys and answers the picked key; ignore answers on the tick a menu opened, so the press that opened it never picks. ctx.slots().save(slot, label) and .load(slot) queue (a save while slots.busy() refuses save-busy); read their results in slots.events() a later tick and show a toast (Toasts::push, Toasts::show). Do not hand-roll save files with ctx.save. A check walks the menu by key: it finds pause.save in state().hud.widgets, presses the keys or taps its rect, saves, loads, then reads state().volatile.saves.lastLoad.checksumMatch, which must be true; false means state a probe reads is missing from a section. Refusals are typed codes (save-slots-full, save-busy, save-not-configured).
port: One facet owns game.ui, game.saves and the menus; each other facet adds its own state with game.save_section and never writes slots itself.

evidence.note: SaveConfig, save_world and sections, queued saves and loads, slot events, the autosave ring, refusals and state().volatile.saves.lastLoad.checksumMatch.
The kit's Menu, Dialog and lists by pad or keys, widget keys in state().hud.widgets, toasts, and menus-saves ignoring answers on the tick a screen opened.
Every word a key in assets/lang/<locale>.ftl, looked up with genex::ui::tr.
Saves: game.saves(..) and ctx.slots(); UI and settings: game.ui(..) and genex::ui.
